title: Crypto Auros AI Review 2026: Risk Check
description: Thinking of signing up with Crypto Auros AI? Its page offers derivatives trading and a $250 minimum but names no regulator or licence.

excerpt: The name says crypto, but the page lists derivatives trading via wire transfers.
content:
The name says crypto, but the page lists derivatives trading via wire transfers. The page is headed "smart move or mistake?" without an answer, and no licence or company is named. Outside verification was not run.

What the page says

  • Platform type: online trading platform
  • Technology: intelligent automation
  • Minimum deposit: min $250
  • Asset class: derivatives
  • Payment methods: local wire transfers
  • Withdrawal: withdrawal within 24h
  • Registration fee: no sign-up or trading fee
  • Support: continuous support

What we could not check

We have not run regulator or security-database checks on this platform for this review. The page does not name a regulator, licence or company.
